observations.title: Milestone 1 seed-to-application proof
observations.אדון_הכל: Manifested and verified: application, API and CLI.
observations.הבט: A runnable generated application artifact exists.
observations.הבן: This proves bounded seed-to-application generation, not root self-hosting.
observations.חקור: Every L1-L13 verification gate passed.
observations.מלך_עולם: The application seed is the verified canonical authority.
observations.ראה: The seed and generated product resolve to one identity.

observations.title: Manual compiler: 74 products in four groups
observations.אדון_הכל: Manifested and verified: application, API and GUI.
observations.הבט: A public review branch and pull request exist.
observations.הבן: Review and merge the product-family dependency before this stacked change.
observations.חקור: The complete local proof passed within the five-second law.
observations.מלך_עולם: ROOT pins every current creator authority.
observations.ראה: Every product identity is derived from registered seed data.

observations.title: ROOT creator is pinned but not root-generated
observations.אדון_הכל: Manifested: partial repository; the root-generated repository is absent.
observations.הבט: The trusted creator exists as handwritten infrastructure.
observations.הבן: The creator must still be generated from ROOT before Milestone 2 can close.
observations.חקור: The repository-wide fixed-point proof remains open.
observations.מלך_עולם: ROOT is pinned but does not yet generate its creator.
observations.ראה: Authority remains divided between ROOT and handwritten creator code.

observations.title: Clean-room whole-repository fixed point
observations.אדון_הכל: No clean-room root-generated repository has manifested yet.
observations.הבט: The clean-room integration issue and contract exist.
observations.הבן: Begin only after dependency provenance and root generation are complete.
observations.חקור: Acceptance is declared; the clean-room result is not yet proven.
observations.מלך_עולם: The completion contract is recorded as authority.
observations.ראה: Required root-generation dependencies remain open.

observations.title: Expose approved AI request
observations.אדון_הכל: Requested application and API projections have not manifested.
observations.הבט: A user request is stored in the local queue.
observations.הבן: The user must authorize the external destination before delivery.
observations.חקור: No external AI or GitHub delivery has been executed.
observations.מלך_עולם: A future seed must declare the audited external delivery boundary.
observations.ראה: The request is identified but not yet authorized for external delivery.
